label: Citywide MHA
detail: Mandatory Housing Affordability takes effect citywide (Ord. 125791). It had applied to six areas since 2017.

label: ADU reform
detail: Two ADUs per lot; owner-occupancy and parking requirements removed (CB 119544).

label: Interim middle housing
detail: Interim middle-housing ordinance passed for state HB 1110 (CB 120969). Date is passage; effective date not yet confirmed.
